curatorNote: Generated by `corepack pnpm nj:ballot --write` from the Morris County Clerk's CURRENT filed-candidate PDFs, discovered from the clerk's own page hrefs on 2026-09-06 — the clerk republishes at a new version path on every revision, and a hardcoded URL reads a superseded filing as current. 275 candidates read across 2 document(s). The clerk's ballot-position drawing PDF is a scan with no text layer, so ballot order is not machine-readable and candidates render alphabetically by surname. The filings carry party, slogan, term and seats; they state neither incumbency nor websites, so those fields are null throughout. Filed emails and street addresses are contact data and are written to data/states/nj/ballot/nj-morris-2026-contacts.json rather than into this file.
